name: iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/* (pass ANY role in the account) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 3 regression, WILDCARD-RESOURCE side. role/* is a resource-TYPE-prefixed ARN: concrete type head 'role' plus a leading-wildcard identifier, so it names EVERY role in the account. The old head-only broadness check saw head='role' (concrete) and returned isBroadArnResource=false, so resourceIsBroad=false and a non-read grant (iam:PassRole) on all-roles reported findings=[] exit 0 CLEAN - a WILDCARD-RESOURCE fail-open. PassRole is a non-read/mutating action, so a broad (account-wide) resource scope on it is a meaningful, remediable WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high). Contrast the negative passrole-specific-role-not-broad (role/app-worker-readonly, a concrete name) which must stay quiet.
